text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...Haaah, Trainer-san. Lately, something 
has been wrong with me, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I don't have a fever, YES. Nothing hurts, 
YES. And yet, my body has felt so heavy 
this whole time...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Could I be sick with something? Even 
though I eat my vegetables to stay 
healthy...

As she speaks, Taiki Shuttle chooses a 
hamburger steak and a mountain of french 
fries.
choice_data_list: Time to rethink your eating habits!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What!? But this is a healthy veggie 
lifestyle, you know!? I eat chips at 
night, too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Come on now, Trainer-san. That kind of 
joke won't work on meee..."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...Is it really no good, perchaaance? 
Really?

After that, I revamped Taiki Shuttle's 
meal plan and brought her diet to a 
successful conclusion.
